item.title: FPGA: Creating a MIPI PL pipeline on the TE0950
item.author: Jack Bonnell
item.description: This week I have been bringing up a MIPI camera pipeline on the Trenz TE0950, taking frames from a Raspberry Pi Camera Module v2 (Sony IMX219) through the Versal PL and out over Ethernet to VLC. Getting Vivado 2024.2, the soft-reset / IRQ wiring, and PetaLinux’s V4L2 stack to agree took more patience than the block design alone suggests. Overview This project is on the 2024.2 Xilinx toolchain (Vivado + PetaLinux).
